answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The gale holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
